review.notes: All OCR lines compared against extracted text of all 19 physical PDF pages with a word-level coverage diff; physical pages 1-3, 5-7 rendered with the author block, front-matter lines, the 'Additionaly' spelling and every footnote re-verified at 300 dpi crops. Pages 8-19 (results tables and references) got the automated word-coverage pass, reference-list completeness through the final entry (Zhou et al., 2023) and spot checks only, not a line-by-line render comparison. Superscript affiliation digits and reference entries produce spurious coverage-diff tokens (author-name+digit concatenation, 'XSto-/ryCloze' splits, printed page numbers); verified as false positives.
